summary: A Palestinian Islamist movement founded during the first intifada in 1987, which won the Palestinian legislative election of 2006 and has governed the Gaza Strip since 2007. It led the attack on southern Israel of 7 October 2023. It is here because the Gaza war is a record in this atlas and the actors it already holds — a Palestine that ends in 1948 and a Gaza that ends in 1967 — cannot stand for the party that fought it.
